definitions.description: Part produced by the first operation and consumed by the second.

definitions.name: Finished Product
definitions.description: Final product released after the second operation.

definitions.name: Finish Part
definitions.description: Finish and release the intermediate part.

definitions.name: Forming Station
definitions.description: Dedicated station for the forming operation.

definitions.name: Finishing Station
definitions.description: Dedicated station for the finishing operation.

usages.name: Intermediate Part
usages.description: Part passed from forming to finishing.
